A Mizar account is optional on Android: the local network and the dev-host pairing work without one. Signed in, the relay session is attributable to you, and paid time arrives as a redemption code.
Not available on this version of Android

A notification whose kind is switched off is dropped when it arrives, whatever Android is set to. The line above is the system permission: if it says notifications are off, no switch here can bring them back.

On, a message sent while a turn is running is handed to the model immediately as guidance, without interrupting it. Off, it waits above the field and is sent when the turn ends; the bar can also send it as guidance now, put it back in the field, or throw it away.
Off is a rule, not a preference: this phone does not use the computer\'s local address at all, an open local link is closed at once, and reconnects use the relay.
The on-device agent is not included in this build yet. It is being ported behind its own module; this shelf is where its configuration and its stored sessions will live.
Sessions written by the on-device agent are kept on this phone. Clearing removes them; the workspace folders and the model configuration are kept.
The on-device agent works only while this app is in the foreground. Leaving the app or locking the screen stops a running turn. It does not use the relay and does not consume account credits.
Files the model delivered are kept on this phone so a second look does not send them again. Clearing them frees the space; the next preview reads the file from the computer.
Deletes the conversations, the session list and the workspaces this phone kept, then reads them from your computer again. Nothing on the computer changes.
Everything this phone kept about your sessions is deleted first, then read again from your computer. Your account and your settings are kept.
No app answered the group card. The group number is on the clipboard.
Both rows leave the app rather than opening a page of their own: the browser is the operator\'s, with the operator\'s history, and the group lives in its own app.

Device tokens and pairing codes are removed before the file is written, and conversations are not in it. The slow typewriter is a diagnostic that stretches the reveal to eight seconds so it can be watched.

Install AGI Mizar on your computer
This phone is the remote. The computer it drives needs AGI Mizar installed and running before the two can be paired.
Open GitHub Releases and take the installer for your platform.
Run it on the computer you want this phone to drive, and leave it running.
The next step pairs this phone with that computer.

A Mizar account carries the relay session. On Android it is optional: the local network works without one.
Signing in makes every relay session attributable to one person. No conversations or files are stored on the account server, and nothing is lost by waiting.
